settings.question: Are these official licensed jerseys?
settings.answer: Novora jerseys are premium fan-edition replicas with the same look, colors, and crests as match kits, at a fraction of the retail price. They are not sold as licensed merchandise.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Our jerseys run true to size with a standard athletic cut. S fits a 36" chest, M a 40", L a 44", XL a 48", XXL a 52". If you are between sizes or prefer a looser fit, size up.

settings.question: Can I add my own name and number?
settings.answer: Yes, and it is free. Enter your name and number in the personalization fields on the product page before adding to cart. Please note that personalized jerseys are final sale.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: We ship worldwide and delivery is typically 7–14 days, often sooner depending on your location. You will receive a tracking number once your order ships.

settings.question: Which nations are available?
settings.answer: We currently carry 16 nations: Argentina, France, Portugal, Brazil, England, Spain, Germany, Uruguay, Netherlands, Mexico, USA, Japan, Morocco, Colombia, Croatia, and Senegal.

settings.question: What if it does not fit?
settings.answer: Non-personalized jerseys can be returned within 30 days for a size exchange or a full refund, no questions asked.
